The ending feels entirely natural, purposeful, and earned because it reaches the exact thematic and literal moment the entire story has been building toward: the installation of the missing membrane. Even though the construction project itself is not yet fully finished, the emotional and thematic arc of the story finds complete closure. Helen, who has patiently endured the slow degradation of her workspace and the fracturing of her department, gets to physically touch the three-eighths-of-an-inch layer that had been missing for over half a century. This quiet climactic moment ties together the central motifs of time, patience, and institutional endurance, allowing Helen to return to her office—and the reader to leave the story—with a profound sense of resolution.
